If
you
can
read
a
clock
,
you
can
know
the
time
of
day
.
But
no
one
knows
what
time
itself
is
.
We
cannot
see
it
.
We
cannot
touch
it
.
We
cannot
hear
it
.
We
know
it
only
by
the
way
we
mark
its
passing
.
For
all
our
success
in
measuring
the
smallest
parts
of
time
,
time
remains
one
of
the
great
mysteries
of
the
universe
.
One
way
to
think
about
time
is
to
imagine
a
world
without
time
.
There
could
be
no
movement
because
time
and
movement
cannot
be
separated
.
A
world
without
time
could
exist
only
as
long
as
there
were
no
changes
.
For
time
and
change
are
linked
.
We
know
that
time
has
passed
when
something
changes
.
